narratives.briefing: It is a full 12-game slate, and every one of the report's five props is an under, all rated Consider rather than anything stronger. The clearest edge is Jarrett Allen under 9.5 rebounds, where the sim goes under in 87% of games against a DraftKings price that implies 50%. The report has no graded record yet (morning 0-0-0), so treat these as untested; the game-line leans are 12-22 for -11.35u since 2026-11-11 and stay leans only.
